prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1033; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the wrist. Imaging was consistent with a wrist fracture, and the reported mechanism of injury is well matched to the force of the crash. Over the course of eleven visits, care proceeded along a typical trajectory: immobilization, pain management, and progressive range-of-motion and strengthening work. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and function returned. On examination, localized tenderness and reduced grip strength over the fractured area are present and support the diagnosis, while neurovascular checks, sensation, and the remaining joint tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to this area, and no earlier records of wrist problems were identified. Billing reflects the services rendered, with no duplicate or repeated charges for the same care.
